description: Use when the user asks how prospective a location in Western Australia is for a metal (Au, Cu, Ni, W, Sn, Co, Ta, Mn). Returns the model's prospectivity score (%), tier, data coverage and uncertainty, the nearest known mineral site, the geochemical and geophysical signals behind the score with each sub-model's score and weight, and a mapUrl that opens the point on the web map.
name: score_point
title: Score a point's prospectivity
